name: Pashupatinath
description: Pashupatinath is a famous Hindu temple complex located on the banks of the Bagmati River in Kathmandu, Nepal. It is dedicated to Lord Shiva and is one of the most significant religious sites for Hindus worldwide. The temple is known for its stunning architecture, intricate carvings, and sacred rituals. It attracts thousands of pilgrims and tourists every year, especially during the Maha Shivaratri festival.
